pages.title: Abilities
pages.text: $(l)Load$(): Takes aboard own ground units of its race nearby: a flyer 8 slots, a bunker 4 (6 with neosteel), a command center 5 SCVs, a nydus any zerg$(br2)$(l)Unload$(): Flies there and puts the cargo down; a building lets it out (a nydus the cargo of all its ends); a click on a rider in the panel lets it out alone$(br2)$(l)Ventral Sacs$(): The overlord morphs into a transport (25/25, 12 s; needs a lair)
